decisions_not_to_reverse: Raw/source evidence is authority; derived summaries and goldens cannot replace it.
PIR owns pedagogy semantics; study-os-benchmarker owns independent scoring; Study OS adopts pinned tested PIR revisions.
PAM is a pinned assurance methodology and validation shell, not a runtime dependency and not pedagogy logic.
Visible regression, masked regression, sealed holdout, and prospective evaluation are distinct evidence classes.
A hidden case opened for debugging is permanently contaminated and must be retired into regression.
The immediate program objective is proof-producing extraction and benchmark output, not additional architecture for its own sake.
The experimental max-sum vertical proof is a falsification/fit test, not permission to freeze a general pedagogy ontology.
A passing structural test may prove only its stated narrow claim; it does not imply compiler generalization or learning efficacy.
Source accounting and semantic review are separate claims: 887/887 accounting is complete, while canonical semantic disposition/golden compilation is not yet complete.
The full transcript has already falsified mandatory-window-box representation as a general PIR assumption; do not reinterpret enumerate as a window merely to preserve the schema.
